def compress_ranges(lst):
    out = []
    n = len(lst)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j + 1 < n and lst[j + 1] == lst[j] + 1:
            j += 1
        out.append([lst[i], lst[j]])
        i = j + 1
    return out

def interleave_lists(a, b):
    n = min(len(a), len(b))
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append(a[i])
        out.append(b[i])
    out.extend(a[n:])
    out.extend(b[n:])
    return out

def zigzag_merge(lst):
    s = sorted(lst)
    out = []
    i, j = 0, len(s) - 1
    take_low = True
    while i <= j:
        if take_low:
            out.append(s[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            out.append(s[j])
            j -= 1
        take_low = not take_low
    return out

def stable_partition_positive_negative(nums):
    positives = [x for x in nums if x >= 0]
    negatives = [x for x in nums if x < 0]
    return positives + negatives
